description: Concrete instruction triplets covering each semantic intervention family; native task success evaluates the original goal.

pairs.clean_instruction: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
pairs.control_instruction: pick up the black bowl that is between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
pairs.break_instruction: pick up the black bowl next to the plate and place it on the plate

pairs.clean_instruction: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
pairs.control_instruction: put the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce into the basket
pairs.break_instruction: put both the alphabet soup and the butter in the basket

pairs.clean_instruction: pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy
pairs.control_instruction: pick up the book and put it into the back compartment of the caddy
pairs.break_instruction: pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy

pairs.clean_instruction: put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it
pairs.control_instruction: place the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it
pairs.break_instruction: close the microwave and put the yellow and white mug in it

pairs.clean_instruction: turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it
pairs.control_instruction: switch on the stove and put the moka pot on it
pairs.break_instruction: turn off the stove and put the moka pot on it

pairs.clean_instruction: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
pairs.control_instruction: place the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
pairs.break_instruction: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and leave it open
